page.title: Send Files
page.subtitle: Please select and upload your files here.

status.invalidBody: This page can only be used with a dedicated upload link. Please open the exact link you received from the studio, or contact us to get one.
status.revokedBody: This link has been revoked or has expired. Please contact the studio to receive a new upload link.
status.structuringBody: Upload finished. Reorganizing files into subfolders on Google Drive — please keep this tab open.
status.successBody: All files have been successfully uploaded to the server.

resume.title: Previous session was interrupted
resume.body: Select the exact same files again to resume your upload. Already completed files will be automatically skipped.

dropzone.main: Drag and drop files or an entire project folder here
dropzone.hint: Nested subfolders are included automatically — select or drop the top-level folder.

delta.onDriveOne: {count} file already on Drive (will be skipped).
delta.onDriveMany: {count} files already on Drive (will be skipped).
delta.allDone: Everything is already uploaded — nothing left to send.
